topic: Unplanned holiday spending on credit vs a gift cap and monthly saving (Wally vs Theodora)

scenes.narration: January credit card pain is built every December, on purpose. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a wrapped gift in one hand and a January statement in the other, comic burst banner reads BUILT IN DECEMBER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wally and Theodora each have eleven people to buy for.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man wally and woman theodora holding long gift lists, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both start shopping in a crowded week of December.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a busy shopping street in December with both of them in the crowd, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wally buys whatever looks good, tracking nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wally piling gifts into a cart with no list in sight, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He spends fourteen hundred and carries it into January.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wally crushed under a barbell stamped FOURTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: At twenty four percent interest, payoff takes nine months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a calendar with nine months shaded and an interest meter running, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Theodora sets a twenty five dollar cap per person.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman theodora writing TWENTY FIVE DOLLAR CAP on a gift list, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The family agrees to draw names instead of buying everyone gifts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a family drawing names from a bowl labeled ONE NAME EACH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She saved fifty dollars monthly since January for gifts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman theodora dropping fifty dollars into a jar labeled GIFT FUND each month, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her holiday total is four hundred, paid in cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman theodora paying cash at a counter, receipt reading FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same holiday, same family, one thousand dollars apart.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two identical holiday scenes with a scoreboard reading ONE THOUSAND APART, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Set a cap and save monthly for it. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading CAP IT AND FUND IT, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
